_comment: Display names for the sixteen pet kinds in `fiddle/pets.toml`.
The game names every *variant* ('Tabby Cat', 'Lava Cat') but states no
name for the kind itself — `pet_kind = "flying_tome"` is a token, and a
token must never be de-snake-cased into a name mechanically. Each name
here is taken from the game's own variant names: where one variant exists
its stated name IS the kind's name, and where several exist the shared
noun they all end in is used. `oreclod` is the one kind whose variants
share no noun (Copperclod, Ironclod, Silverclod, Goldclod) — 'Oreclod' is
our reading of the token, marked as such.
A kind missing from this file is dropped from the build AND counted, so a
game patch adding a seventeenth pet shows up as a warning, not silence.

cat.name: Cat
cat.source: shared noun of 12 stated variant names ('Tabby Cat' …)

dog.name: Dog
dog.source: shared noun of 12 stated variant names ('Yellow Dog' …)

sapling.name: Sapling
sapling.source: shared noun of 6 stated variant names ('Green Sapling' …)

mushroom.name: Mushroom
mushroom.source: stated variant name 'Mushroom' (mushroom_red); the other three prefix it

rockclod.name: Rockclod
rockclod.source: stated variant name 'Rockclod' (rockclod); the other three prefix it

oreclod.name: Oreclod
oreclod.source: our reading of the pet_kind token — the four variants (Copperclod…Goldclod) share no noun

enchantern.name: Enchantern
enchantern.source: shared noun of 2 stated variant names ('Yellow Enchantern', 'Blue Enchantern')

stalagmite.name: Stalagmite
stalagmite.source: stated variant name 'Stalagmite' (stalagmite_blue); the other two prefix it

flame_spirit.name: Flame Spirit
flame_spirit.source: shared noun of 2 stated variant names ('Orange Flame Spirit', 'Purple Flame Spirit')

griffin_statue.name: Gryphon Statue
griffin_statue.source: stated variant name 'Gryphon Statue' (sole variant) — the game spells the token 'griffin' and the name 'Gryphon'; the stated name wins
